content: Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT), as recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), emphasizes the importance of behavioral and physical activity modifications. Behavioral changes are critical for sustaining long-term weight loss. Engaging in regular physical activity, when combined with appropriate dietary management, contributes to improved glycemic control, as evidenced by reductions in A1C levels, and enhances cardiovascular health. Both aerobic and resistance exercises are strongly encouraged for individuals with diabetes to support effective weight management and to promote better metabolic health.
